LIVEKITAVCLIENT.connectErrorCheckClock: A secure token could not be created. Please check the date & time on your computer to ensure that they are set accurately
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.connectionInfoMissing: LiveKit connection information missing; please provide a Server Address, API Key, and Secret
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioMusicModeHint: Configures audio input for music streaming by adjusting bitrate and disabling echo cancelation & noise suppression. This should not be used for normal voice communication.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioMusicModeRateHint: The bitrate used for audio when Music Mode is enabled. Increasing this will affect bandwidth and resource requirements on all clients.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.enhancedNoiseCancellatio: Use an open-source AI model to remove background noise from your microphone. Runs entirely in your browser and works with self-hosted LiveKit servers. Enabled by default. Requires a modern browser with AudioWorklet support. Automatically disabled while Music Mode is active.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.noiseSuppressionModelHin: Which noise suppression model to use when Enhanced Noise Cancellation is enabled. GTCRN (the default) is a stronger neural model with the best quality at a higher CPU cost; RNNoise is a balanced choice; Speex is the lightest on CPU. Krisp is LiveKit's noise filter and is only available when connected to a LiveKit Cloud server with a supported browser; otherwise GTCRN is used instead.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.krispUnsupportedFallback: Krisp noise cancellation is not supported by this browser; using {fallback} instead.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.noiseSuppressionFailed: Noise cancellation ({model}) could not be started; using {fallback} instead. Check the browser console for details.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.voiceGateFailed: Input sensitivity could not be started, so your microphone is sent without it in Voice Activity mode. Check the browser console for details.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.discordStyleUIHint: Show a voice panel with mute, deafen, and voice settings, a speaking ring and avatar on camera views, and a right-click menu to change each user's volume (up to 200%).
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.dockFollowSpeakerHint: In the focus layout, show whoever speaks
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.dockFloatingSettingHint: Move the dock by its header and resize it by its corner, instead of docking it on a side of the screen.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.hideFromDockHint: Also mutes them. Show them again from the player list.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.inputSensitivityAutoHint: The bar turns green while your voice is being sent.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.inputSensitivityHint: Drag the marker: audio quieter than it is not sent. Threshold:
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.settingsMenuHint: All settings for voice, video, the LiveKit server, and the camera dock are in the A/V settings window.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.pushToTalkDelayHint: Keep sending audio this long after releasing the key, so the end of words isn't cut off.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioNoiseSuppressionMod: Only used when noise cancellation is off; the selected model replaces it.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.clientSetting.disableVid: Camera views show avatars instead of video.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.clientSetting.borderColo: Outline each camera view in its player's color.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.discordStyleUIDisabledBy: Turned off by the GM for this world.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.avModeHint: What players can share in this world. Changing it reloads the world.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.connection.urlHint: For example myproject.livekit.cloud or livekit.example.com, without https:// or wss://.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.tavernSaveFirst: Save your changes first, then sign in with Patreon.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.liveKitAccountLogoutErro: Error signing out of your Patreon account.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.allowDiscordStyleUIHint: When off, players see Foundry's standard camera dock without the voice panel, speaking rings, and volume menu.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.allowKrispHint: Krisp is only available on LiveKit Cloud. When off, players who picked it use the default open-source model.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.defaultNoiseModelHint: Used by players who haven't picked a model themselves. Krisp falls back to GTCRN when unavailable.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.resetRoomDone: The meeting room ID has been reset.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioQualityPresetHint: The audio quality/bitrate preset used when publishing your microphone. Higher presets improve fidelity at the cost of bandwidth. Music Mode overrides this with the highest quality preset.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioAutoGainControlHint: Automatically adjust microphone volume to keep a consistent level. Disable if you manage input gain yourself. Ignored while Music Mode is enabled.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioEchoCancellationHin: Remove echo picked up from your speakers. Disable when using headphones for slightly cleaner audio. Ignored while Music Mode is enabled.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioNoiseSuppressionHin: Use the browser's built-in noise suppression. Ignored while Music Mode is enabled.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.audioNoiseGateThresholdH: The level below which your microphone is silenced in Voice Activity mode. Lower values (e.g. -70 dB) let quieter sounds through; higher values (e.g. -30 dB) require louder speech to be sent.
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.debugHint: Enables CONFIG.debug.av and CONFIG.debug.avclient for extra logging
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.disableReceivingAudioHin: Don't subscribe to other users' audio tracks
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.disableReceivingAudioWar: Receiving audio is disabled in LiveKit AVClient Module Settings
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.disableReceivingVideoHin: Don't subscribe to other users' video tracks. May be helpful if your bandwidth or CPU is limited
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.disableReceivingVideoWar: Receiving video is disabled in LiveKit AVClient Module Settings
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.displayConnectionQuality: Display a connection quality indicator beside each player's name to show the quality of their connection to the LiveKit server
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.liveKitTraceHint: Enables trace logging of the LiveKit client library
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.resetRoomHint: Reset the meeting room ID used for your A/V
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.serverTypeNotes: Type of LiveKit server to connect to
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.serverDetailsTavern: Subscribe to the At the Tavern Patreon
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.simulcastHint: Use simulcast video tracks with LiveKit. This may help low-resource clients and the expense of some video tracks not being sent or received by them
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.tokenError: Could not generate LiveKit access token; check your A/V Server settings
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.useExternalAVHint: (Experimental) Opens a LiveKit web client for A/V in separate browser window
LIVEKITAVCLIENT.externalAVJoinMessage: Join A/V with LiveKit web client?

LIVEKITAVCLIENT.tavernAccountPatreonHint: Sign in with your Patreon account to access the Tavern LiveKit cluster
